name: CURE
source:
You get taken away to a quarantine facility after contacting a disease with no cure. Being taken care of by Allan, will you be cured?

[From [url=https://louzivqx.itch.io/cure]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你染上了一種無藥可治的疾病，被送進隔離設施。艾倫照料著你，你能痊癒嗎？
